papāta m. and mfn. [ S. prapāta, m. ], 1. a cliff, a precipice, a steep rock or bank; precipitous, sloping steeply; Vin II 237, 20 (mahāsamuddo … anupubbaninno … na āyataken’ eva ~o; Sp 1287, 12 foll.: na paṭhamam eva gambhīro anupubbena gambhīro ti attho); III 74, 16 (sobbhe vā narake vā ~e vā papatā ti; Sp 443, 12 : ~o ti pabbatantare vā thalantare vā ekato chinno hoti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr ~ā ti); 82, 21 (pabbataṃ abhirūhitvā ~e papatanto); D II 330, 15 (satthaṃ vā āhareyyuṃ … ~e vā papateyyuṃ); M I 11, 1 (bhikkhu … sobbhaṃ ~aṃ candanikaṃ oḷigallaṃ [parivajjeti]; Ps I 80, 25 : ekato chinnataṭaṃ); S III 108, 25 (dakkhissasi sobbhaṃ ~aṃ; 109, 8 : sobbho ~o ti … kodhūpāyāsass’ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ); A IV 438, 21 (tesaṃ no bhante amhākaṃ gihīnaṃ kāmabhogīnaṃ … ~o viya khāyati yad idaṃ nekkhammaṃ); Th 869 (coro asiṃ āvudhaṃ ca sobbhe ~e narake anvakāsi); Ja II 118, 6 (bodhisattaṃ … piṭṭhiyaṃ paharitvā ~e pātetvā); V 70, 6* (tindukaṃ addakkhiṃ … ~am abhilambantaṃ); VI 306, 20* (so lambamāno narake ~e); 306, 28* (maṃ ~asmiṃ papātum icchasi); 498, 19* (seyyo visaṃ me khāyitaṃ ~ā papateyy’ ahaṃ); Ap 126, 24 (~am anugacchanto); Mil 109, 5 (~e pātetvā hatthaṃ deti); Vism 559, 33 (yathā ~e patitapuriso parassa paccayo hotuṃ na sakkoti); Saddh 208 (~aṃ va bhayānakaṃ passanto); — ifc see cora- ( sv cora 1 ), chinna- ( sv chindati ); — 2. a fall, falling; S V 47, 29 (rukkho pācīnaninno … so mūle chinno katamena ~ena papateyyā ti yena bhante ninno …, Ce, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be katamena papateyyā ti; Se mūlachinde kate papatessati);
